declarations.description:
Lets the reader choose the part of an image to keep — an avatar from a photo, a banner from a screenshot — and
hands the app that part as a canvas or a blob. The selection is drawn over the image with the rest dimmed; drag it
to move it, drag a handle to resize it, or drag on the image outside it to draw a new one. Escape, or the browser taking the pointer away, cancels a drag.

The selection is one tab stop. Arrow keys move it (Shift for ten times the step), Alt + Arrow keys move its right or
bottom edge, and `+`/`-` scale it around its centre; the new size and position are announced.

`crop` is the selection in the image's natural pixels, whatever size it renders at. Leave it unset and the cropper
selects the centred 80% of the image once it loads. `aspect-ratio` locks the proportions (`1`, `16/9`, `4:3`);
`shape="ellipse"` rounds the selection and clips the output to it, for avatars. `toCanvas()` and `toBlob()` draw the
selection at its natural size, or at the size you give. A cross-origin image needs `crossorigin` and CORS headers,
or the browser refuses to read the canvas back.
declarations.name: ImageCropper

cssProperties.description: Largest height the image renders at; it is scaled down to fit the width as well.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__image--max-height

cssProperties.description: Height of the frame while there is no image.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__frame--min-height

cssProperties.description: Shows through transparent pixels and around an image narrower than the host.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__frame--background

cssProperties.description: Room around the image, so the handles on its edges stay inside the frame.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__frame--padding

cssProperties.description: Dims the image outside the selection.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__overlay--color

cssProperties.description: Drawn around the selection while it is keyboard-focused.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-cropper__selection__focus--outline

cssParts.description: Box around the image; centres it and draws the background behind transparent pixels. Without a `src` it wraps the `placeholder` slot instead (no fallback content).
cssParts.name: frame

cssParts.description: The selected area: its outline, guides and handles.
cssParts.name: selection

cssParts.description: Each resize handle. Edge handles are hidden while `aspect-ratio` is set.
cssParts.name: handle

slots.description: Shown while there is no `src`; put an upload control here.
slots.name: placeholder

members.name: src
members.description: URL of the image to crop. Replacing it selects the centred 80% of the new image, unless `crop` changes too.

members.name: alt
members.description: Alternative text of the image.

members.name: crossOrigin
members.description: CORS mode of the image request (`anonymous`, `use-credentials`); needed to read a cross-origin image back with `toCanvas`/`toBlob`.

members.name: aspectRatio
members.description: Locks the selection's width-to-height ratio: `1`, `16/9`, `4:3` or `1.5`. Unset or `0` leaves it free.

members.name: shape
members.description: `ellipse` rounds the selection and makes `toCanvas`/`toBlob` clip to it (transparent corners in a PNG).

members.name: crop
members.description: The selection, in the image's natural pixels (JSON in markup). Set by the cropper once the image loads when left unset; kept inside the image and refitted around its centre when it is off `aspect-ratio`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Locks the selection: no dragging, no keyboard, not focusable.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the selection. Defaults to "Crop area" in the nearest `lang` (English, or a language the app adds).

members.name: pointerFocus
members.description: The selection was focused by a pointer: no focus ring until a key is pressed.

members.name: naturalWidth
members.description: Width of the loaded image in its natural pixels; `0` until it loads.

members.name: naturalHeight
members.description: Height of the loaded image in its natural pixels; `0` until it loads.

members.name: reset
members.description: Selects the centred 80% of the image again, at the current `aspect-ratio`.

members.name: toCanvas
members.description:
Draws the selection on a new canvas, at its natural size unless `width` and/or `height` say otherwise. Throws an
`InvalidStateError` until the image has loaded; reading a cross-origin image back needs `crossorigin`.

members.name: toBlob
members.description: The selection as an image file (PNG unless `type` says otherwise; `quality` from 0 to 1 for JPEG and WebP).

members.name: initialCrop
members.description: The largest rectangle at `aspect-ratio` inside the image, scaled to the initial coverage and centred.

members.name: bounded
members.description: Keeps a rectangle inside the image, shrinking it first if it is larger.

members.name: fitted
members.description: `crop` kept inside the image and at `aspect-ratio`, or the initial selection when there is none.

members.name: fitRatio
members.description: The rectangle at `aspect-ratio` with the same area and centre as `crop`, made to fit the image.

members.name: scale
members.description: Natural pixels per rendered pixel.

members.name: spanned
members.description:
The rectangle spanned by a fixed `anchor` and the `point` the pointer drags, flipping when the point crosses the
anchor. `axes` limits which sides follow the pointer (an edge handle moves one); the others keep `base`.

members.name: handlePointerCancel
members.description: The browser took the pointer away (a system gesture, palm rejection): undo the drag rather than commit it.

members.name: cancelGesture
members.description: Ends the current drag and puts the selection back where it started.

members.name: commit
members.description: Sets the selection and fires `crop-input` when it changed.

events.description: Fired while the reader changes the selection (every step of a drag). Not fired for changes made by script. Does not bubble.
events.name: crop-input

events.description: Fired when the reader commits a change: the pointer is released or a key moved the selection. Does not bubble.
events.name: crop-change

events.description: The image has loaded (re-dispatched from the inner image).
events.name: load

events.description: The image failed to load (re-dispatched from the inner image).
events.name: error
